data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ab' which means 'father', and 'ya' which means 'creatures'. Abyah is a name that signifies the one who is the father of all creatures. This name holds a deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture, reminding us of Allah's infinite mercy and compassion as the Creator of all things. The name Abyah carries the meaning “Father of Creatures” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abyah usually hope their child will grow to embody father of creatures and live with faith, good character and purpose.
